method: Robust broad log-RGB medians from reliable actual visible texels, smoothed by physical height and extended around each ring. Bounded observed detail remains inside the trusted projection; zero-mean inferred grain supplies other areas. Original color can be blended by amount.
limits: Regional tone may still include residual illumination. A continuous color map is not proof of original pigment or grain. Fresh fixed/side/rear BSDF renders and independent scope checks are required.
